question: With what kind of lamps should the sacred fire be honored in this rite?
premises: Lamps are used in relation to the fire.
The lamps arise from growing trees.
The fire is the object of the action.
inference: The sacred fire should be honored with lamps made from growing trees.
uncertainties: The exact material sense of vardhamānatarūtthābhiḥ is uncertain.
plain_english: One should honor the fire with lamps made from growing trees.
